entities.name: Gadwick, the Wizened
entities.description: Human wizard of Eldraine and archmage of Vantress, master of Johann.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: Court of Eldraine led by the Magic Mirror Indrelon and its archmage.

entities.name: Johann
entities.description: Elementalist chosen as Gadwick's apprentice who accidentally burned down the tower.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: Sentient Magic Mirror that led Vantress, spending most of its time underwater.

entities.name: Caervelin
entities.description: Gadwick's residence, whose tower burned down.

entities.name: Merlin
entities.description: Arthurian legend Gadwick was designed after.

events.summary: Gadwick chooses the elementalist Johann as his apprentice.
events.quote: Gadwick chose the elementalist Johann as his apprentice

events.summary: While Gadwick is away, Johann fails to maintain the mechanisms, burning down the tower at Caervelin.
events.quote: accidentally causing the tower to burn down
